LHX.sentence: L3Harris slipped a touch, but the real story is that it earns thinner profits than the bigger defense contractors — that gap is why the stock has been weak, even though defense spending itself stays strong.

ASML.sentence: ASML dipped a bit this week, but nothing has changed about its unique position as the only company in the world that makes a certain essential chip-printing machine.

LIN.sentence: Linde is quiet — the world's biggest supplier of industrial gases keeps chugging along on long-term contracts, and right now it's trading like an ordinary company rather than the premium one it usually is.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft is calm this week, but it's been quietly outrunning its peers as the AI-cloud story keeps grinding along without drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher had a nice week as money flows back into biotech, which usually means more lab and equipment orders coming its way over the next couple of quarters.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge dipped a little, but it's basically a toll road for oil and gas pipelines that pays a generous, steady dividend — a fairly boring, dependable holding.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow jumped this week even though it's still well below its highs — big companies and government agencies keep signing on for its AI automation tools under long contracts.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore climbed as its mining and commodity-trading business gets more respect from investors, and it's paying a hefty dividend to boot.

RDDT.sentence: Reddit fell again on worries that Google could send it fewer visitors, but the business itself is booming — advertising revenue grew sharply — so it's more a fear story than a business problem right now.

KOF.sentence: The Latin American Coca-Cola bottler had a good day and is near its highs, yet it's still priced quite reasonably for how steady the business is.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is having a good stretch — oil prices are well above what it costs them to pump, which comfortably funds its big dividend, though those profits may be near a peak.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container-shipping giant that hauls goods across the world's oceans, is flat this week — the stock is cheap relative to its fleet, but earnings suggest trade is running at a normal, not depressed, pace.

MA.sentence: Mastercard was basically unchanged, and oddly it's a touch cheaper than Visa even though it's growing faster, while people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: Intuitive Surgical, the maker of the da Vinci surgical robot, rose a bit and now looks unusually cheap by its own standards, with hospitals doing more procedures that each sell more of its supplies.
